verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services firm with client-facing elements such as status dashboards and People Ops integration, so asking whether it offers in-product AI-generated insights is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated insights or suggestions. The viability assessments and case strategy it describes are human-delivered services, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
